data: Keep labels visible, sort complete rows and narrow a sheet by what you see in a column.

Keep labels in view as you scroll. Freeze the rows above and columns to the left of your selection. Drag either divider’s blue grip to move the boundary. Scratch remembers each sheet’s setting. Freeze panes.

Sort rows together. Pick a column and review the row bounds before applying. Formulas, linked notes and annotations follow their source cells. Undo restores the original order. Sort rows.

Filter by what you see. Enter part of a value and move through the matching rows with the keyboard. Click the match count in the footer to clear the filter. CSV exports and Obsidian sync keep the hidden rows. Filter rows.
